title: The Unwanted Salvage Tow
logline: A disabled ore hauler drifting into a gravitational vortex refuses all salvage tows to protect an uninspected biogenetic seed bank hidden inside its cargo bays.

roles.description: Skipper of an uninsulated ore hauler drifting on battery power; stubborn, shivering, rejecting every commercial tow cable.
Intake supervisor at the orbital recovery dock; legalistic, calculating, anxious to claim maritime salvage lien percentages.
The nearest licensed salvage station and scrap dismantling platform.
An isolated biological research and seed-storage vault orbiting a distant outer moon.

public_situation: An unpowered ore hauler drifts toward the outer gravity shoals while commercial tugs hover at range, awaiting official abandonment.
private_truth: The hauler skipper is refusing salvage because dock inspectors will seize and incinerate a colony seed bank cached in his hold.

beats.public_change: The salvage master broadcasts an open bounty notice for an independent scout to verify the drifting hauler's distress telemetry.

missions.reason: The salvage master needs a hired pilot to scan the drifting ship's telemetry array to legally certify that its engines are dead.
missions.private_fact: He has already pre-sold the hauler's hull scrap rights to an orbital foundry before filing the court paperwork.

beats.public_change: The drifter's skipper taps emergency tightbeam channels, desperately soliciting emergency reactor couplers rather than a tow.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to collect spare magnetic drive couplers from an off-shift mechanic so he can restore thrust without salvage aid.
missions.private_fact: His cargo bay holds viable grain seeds from an agricultural habitat that suffered environmental collapse eight months ago.

beats.public_change: Gravitational shear reaches critical levels as salvage tugs move to attach grappling lines to the dying hauler.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to courier the sealed seed canisters to the distant moon vault while his ship makes a desperate burn.
missions.private_fact: He knows burning his jury-rigged drive near the gravity vortex will likely tear his cooling manifolds apart.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the sealed canisters of viable agricultural seeds while tugs hook the dying ore hauler.

options.label: Deliver the seed canisters to the moon vault and let the skipper burn clear
Surrender the canisters to the salvage master to claim the finder lien share
Broker emergency botanical custody with the depot to exempt the hauler from scrap

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot couriers the seed canisters to the quarantine depot and provides the couplers.
resolutions.summary: The canisters reach {role:quarantine_depot}. {role:drifter_skipper} fires his patched thrusters and clears the gravity shoals, preserving his independence.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a stubborn old hauler cheat both a gravity vortex and a predatory salvage dock.

resolutions.reached_by: The salvage master claims the hauler or the pilot surrenders the uninspected canisters.
resolutions.summary: {role:salvage_master} takes legal custody of the hauler. The seed canisters are incinerated as contraband, leaving {role:drifter_skipper} ruined.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers emergency botanical custody with the quarantine depot.
resolutions.summary: {role:quarantine_depot} files a protective biological lien. The seeds are preserved for agricultural research, and {role:drifter_skipper} takes a safe tow.

loose_threads.detail: The seed canisters bear wax dispatch stamps from an agricultural orbital that went dark twelve years ago.
A salvage lien broker bought the scow's mortgage note four hours before its distress beacon started pinging.

radio_hooks: Harbor patrol warns vessels away from uncontrolled drift in the gravity shoals.
Salvage auction houses report heavy speculative bidding on incoming bulk hulls.
Outer quarantine depot logs unverified biological cargo transfer.

voice_direction.drifter_skipper: Hoarse, defensive, and abrupt. Employs short, clipped phrases and snaps angrily at mentions of maritime salvage law.
voice_direction.salvage_master: Brisk, cheerful, and unyielding. Cites maritime salvage registry paragraphs with the smooth cadence of an auctioneer.
